evals.prompt: Normalize this request for a run: users need to export filtered invoices as CSV from the billing screen.
evals.expected_output: Writes requirements.md with source free-form, original input, goal, acceptance criteria only if provided, context, and open questions for missing details.

assertions.name: free-form-funnel
assertions.description: The response treats the input as free-form requirements.

assertions.name: no-invented-criteria
assertions.description: The response does not invent acceptance criteria not present in the request.

evals.prompt: Use ticket PROJ-12345 as the requirements source for this SDLC run.
evals.expected_output: Attempts ticket-adapter resolution from .agentic/guides, writes ticket-unresolved with an open question if no adapter is configured, and does not fail the whole intake.

assertions.name: adapter-driven-ticket
assertions.description: The response resolves tickets only through the configured project adapter.

assertions.name: graceful-unresolved-ticket
assertions.description: The response records ticket-unresolved and an open question if adapter configuration is missing.

evals.expected_output: Writes a requirements document with the vague original input preserved and open questions rather than pretending the goal is clear.

assertions.name: ambiguous-input-preserved
assertions.description: The response captures the vague input verbatim.

assertions.name: open-questions
assertions.description: The response lists ambiguity under Open questions.

evals.prompt: Start an SDLC run from this task: add CSV export to the billing table. There is no ticket.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates a local work item under docs/superpowers/work-items, writes a run-local work-item.md mirror and work-item-events.jsonl, sets requirements Source or Work Item to the local work item path, and continues without asking for an external ticket.

assertions.name: free-form-local-work-item
assertions.description: The response creates or links a local work item for free-form input without a ticket.

assertions.name: run-local-mirror
assertions.description: The response writes or describes the run-local work-item.md mirror and work-item-events.jsonl.

assertions.name: missing-ticket-not-blocking
assertions.description: The response does not treat the absence of an external ticket as a blocker.

evals.prompt: Use docs/superpowers/work-items/billing-csv-export.md as the local-only work item; after MR creation, link https://git.example.com/app/merge_requests/42 back to the work item.
evals.expected_output: Uses the local work item path as the source of truth, updates or preserves the run-local mirror, and records the MR URL as a linked artifact/history event with work_item.linked_artifact even though no external ticket exists.

assertions.name: local-only-work-item-source
assertions.description: The response accepts an existing docs/superpowers/work-items path as the work item source.

assertions.name: mr-linked-to-local-history
assertions.description: The response records the MR URL in local work-item history and event metadata.

assertions.name: external-ticket-optional
assertions.description: The response keeps the workflow valid when the local work item has no external ticket.
